STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE **1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS** - **No Inline CSS:** The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML. - **Class/ID Selectors Only:** All design properties, layout rules, and states are targeted via class/ID selectors in `style.css`. - **Minimal HTML Modifications:** HTML stays semantic and style-agnostic; re-theming must require CSS edits only. **1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens** Store all tokens in `:root` (light) and override in `.dark`: - **Colors (light):** `--primary: #2ECC40`; `--primary-deep: #228B22` (text-safe green per source spec); `--secondary: #40E0D0`; `--accent-sun: #FFD700`; `--accent-earth: #8B4513`; `--accent-burnt: #CC5500`; `--accent-coral: #FF6F61`; `--bg-primary: #FAF5EA` (warm sand off-white derived from Sand Beige — **not** pure white); `--bg-secondary: #FFFFFF`; `--bg-tertiary: #F5DEB3`; `--text-primary: #1E3329`; `--text-secondary: #5C4326`; `--text-success: #1E7A34`; `--text-error: #C0392B`; `--border-default: rgba(139,69,19,0.28)`; `--border-error: #C0392B`; `--border-success: #1E7A34`. - **Colors (dark):** `--bg-primary: #0E211A`; `--bg-secondary: #163028`; `--bg-tertiary: #1F3D33`; `--text-primary: #F4F8EC`; `--text-secondary: #F5DEB3`; `--primary-deep: #7BE382` (remapped lighter so it stays text-safe on dark); `--text-success: #6FE87F`; `--text-error: #FF8A7A`; `--border-default: rgba(64,224,208,0.25)`; keep the vibrant accents (`#2ECC40`, `#40E0D0`, `#FFD700`), which pop on dark surfaces. - **Contrast Pairing:** Every light background token pairs with a dark text token and vice versa — enforced in **both** themes. Vibrant hues (`#2ECC40`, `#FFD700`, `#FF6F61`) must never be used as text on light backgrounds (contrast failure); reserve them for fills/accents and dark-mode text. Verify ≥4.5:1 for all text in both themes. - **Pure-White Exception Clause:** The source palette lists `#FFFFFF`; pure white is permitted **only** as a card/surface fill (`--bg-secondary`), never as the page-wide background; any other near-white need uses `#fefefe`. - **Radius & Shadows:** `--radius-sm: 6px`; `--radius-md: 10px` (per source spec); `--radius-lg: 24px`; `--leaf-radius: 0 50% 0 50%` (leaf silhouette); `--shadow-sm: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)`; `--shadow-md: 0 6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)` (per source spec; deepen opacity in dark mode). - **Spacing & Transitions:** `--spacing-gap: 1.5rem`; `--transition-fast: 0.25s var(--ease-standard)`; `--transition-normal: 0.6s var(--ease-standard)` (per source spec); `--ease-standard: ease-in-out`.
